chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 81: Yuchi Snow’s Fate & the Shadow of Snowdragon Mountain
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning returns home with an Adept, but hope turns to ice. Yuchi Snow has only months to live. A secret past of sacrifice is revealed, and a shadow is cast by Snowdragon Mountain.
og_title: The Price of a Genius: Yuchi Snow’s Last Months
og_description: Adept Mu Xiao diagnoses a fatal exhaustion of life force. Ji Ning must now seek a miracle from the Immortals to save his mother.
twitter_title: Ji Ning learns the true cost of his birth. His mother is dying.
twitter_description: A Wanxiang Adept delivers a death sentence. Only an Immortal’s pill can save Yuchi Snow, pitting Ji Ning against impossible odds.
